svg.title: /groundwork:onboarding — the whole route
svg.desc: Onboarding walks through eight questions — language, issue tracker, workflow, deployment, architecture, review, QA, and anything else — and recommends an answer for each. The answers collect in a draft GROUNDWORK.md, which is saved only after you approve.

g.text: and recommends an answer for each one.

svg.text: Nothing is written to your repository until you approve.
